surface: Complete @mantine/tiptap 9.5.0 runtime surface: RichTextEditor, content, toolbar, control groups, formatting controls, link editing, color controls, source mode, labels, and Link and TaskList helpers.
divergences: The editor renderer and subscriptions use @octanejs/tiptap instead of @tiptap/react.
Control callbacks receive native browser events.
ssr: RichTextEditor follows @octanejs/tiptap's deferred editor construction and deterministic server shell.
